notes: Reconciliation-only. Executed by src/validate_underwriting_performance.py, which independently recomputes both breakdowns and the rejection distribution in pandas (never importing src/etl_spark_underwriting_performance.py's Spark logic).

rules.description: Every (breakdown_type, breakdown_value) row in curated/underwriting_performance.parquet (both the risk_segment and model_version breakdowns) must match an independent pandas recomputation of decision_count, approved_count, rejected_count, manual_review_count, approval_rate, avg_approved_amount, and avg_approved_apr.
curated/underwriting_performance_rejections.parquet's rejection_reason counts must match an independent pandas recomputation from raw underwriting_decisions.
